WITH mx AS (SELECT max(business_date) AS d FROM rpt_daily_store_sales),
ns AS (SELECT r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales) AS net_sales, min(r.business_date) mn, max(r.business_date) mxd FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, mx WHERE r.business_date > mx.d - 364 AND r.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm, s.format, s.close_date, round(ns.net_sales) AS net_sales, rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sqm DESC) AS sqm_rank, rank() OVER (ORDER BY ns.net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, (SELECT d FROM mx) AS maxd
FROM dim_store s LEFT JOIN ns USING (store_id)
WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900
ORDER BY sales_rank
LIMIT 14

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS n, f.sales_line_id AS id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, NULL
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.store_id, cs.store_name,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN n END),0) AS fy2526,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN d >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN n END),0) AS fy2627_ytd,
  count(id) AS lines, count(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_lines
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY fy2526 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS n
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, round(sum(n),2) AS net FROM net_lines WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, round(sum(net_sales),2) AS ctl_net, min(business_date) AS mn, max(business_date) AS mx
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.net, c.ctl_net, round(m.net-c.ctl_net,2) AS diff, c.mn, c.mx
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(store_id)
ORDER BY m.net DESC LIMIT 14

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, f.net_amount AS n, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.etl_loaded_at
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT d, sum(n) AS net, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
         min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
  FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1
), ret AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS d, sum(r.refund_net) AS ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (SELECT business_date AS d, net_sales, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=116)
SELECT m.d, round(m.net - coalesce(r.ret,0),2) AS mine, c.net_sales AS ctl, round(m.net - coalesce(r.ret,0) - c.net_sales,2) AS diff,
       m.lines, m.dist_lines, m.receipts, c.receipts AS ctl_receipts, m.first_load, m.last_load
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ret r USING(d) LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(d)
WHERE m.d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND abs(m.net - coalesce(r.ret,0) - coalesce(c.net_sales,0)) > 0.01
ORDER BY m.d

WITH sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
), net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS n
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, round(sum(n),2) AS net FROM net_lines WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, round(sum(net_sales),2) AS ctl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
), dup AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_rows, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rows FROM fact_sales_line
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.net, c.ctl_net, round(m.net-c.ctl_net,2) AS diff, dup.total_rows, dup.dist_rows
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING(store_id), dup
WHERE abs(m.net-coalesce(c.ctl_net,0)) > 0.01 OR m.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM mine ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY m.net DESC

WITH sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
), net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_amount
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_amount) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, n.store_id, cs.store_name,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY n.store_id, cs.store_name
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 10
